# Precision, measured by hiding 30% of the exact pairs (sk2_match.py match
# --holdout 0.3) and by agreement with Version Tracking: exact, strings and
# ~84%; on functions unchanged since Skate 2, lower on changed ones.
# Exact matches of functions under 6 instructions are 'guess' (stubs match
# unrelated stubs); layout-align pairs are left out (2 of 19 right against
# the game's Lua binding names). Skate 3's own names (names_bindings.tsv)
# take priority. Treat every name here as a lead until a probe confirms it.
